projects.name: Enforcement-Readiness of Generated Kubernetes NetworkPolicies
projects.description: Master thesis at Ankra AB: a tool-agnostic attack-injection benchmark that scores NetworkPolicy generators on block-rate, over-privilege, and false-denies, plus a generation prototype fusing eBPF/Cilium-Hubble flow observation with config-derived dependencies. Shows observation alone plateaus at ~72% of needed edges; fusing config raises coverage to ~82% and cuts false-denies. Evaluated on a live k3s + Cilium cluster against the Ankra control plane and Sock Shop.
